Heatmap

plot_heatmap.Rd

Draw a heatmap from a glyexp::GlycomicSE(), glyexp::GlycoproteomicSE(), or other compatible SummarizedExperiment. Expression values use scale-aware log transformation controlled by log_transform, followed by optional row or column standardization. Before plotting, zero-variance rows and columns are filtered out to ensure robust clustering. Supplied hclust objects must match the retained rows or columns, including their input order.

Usage

plot_heatmap(
  x,
  ...,
  scale = "row",
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  show_colnames = NULL,
  na_col = "grey90",
  log_transform = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  fontsize = 9,
  family = "sans",
  palette = NULL
)

# S3 method for class 'glyexp_experiment'
plot_heatmap(
  x,
  ...,
  scale = "row",
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  show_colnames = NULL,
  na_col = "grey90",
  log_transform = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  fontsize = 9,
  family = "sans",
  palette = NULL
)

# S3 method for class 'SummarizedExperiment'
plot_heatmap(
  x,
  ...,
  scale = "row",
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  show_colnames = NULL,
  na_col = "grey90",
  log_transform = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  fontsize = 9,
  family = "sans",
  palette = NULL
)

Arguments

x

A supported Glycoverse data container.

...

Must be empty. Supply plotting controls by their full argument names.

scale

Standardize rows ("row", the default), columns ("column"), or neither ("none"). Applied after and independently of log_transform.

cluster_rows, cluster_cols

Whether to cluster rows or columns, or compatible hclust objects. Clustering controls order; dendrograms are not drawn. Use autoplot.glystats_hclust_res() to draw a dendrogram.

show_rownames

Whether to display row labels. Defaults to FALSE.

show_colnames

Whether to display column labels. NULL displays them automatically for at most 40 samples.

na_col

Color for missing values.

log_transform

NULL (default) uses recorded abundance scale metadata: raw values are transformed with log2(x + 1e-6), while already logged values are unchanged. FALSE always uses the supplied values unchanged. TRUE requests the same transformation for raw values, but warns and is ignored for already logged values. This argument must be named after ....

title

Optional plot title. Defaults to NULL.

width, height

Plot-area dimensions in millimetres. NULL uses the tidyplots defaults (50 by 50 mm); NA fills the available graphics device. These are not export-page dimensions.

fontsize

Base text size in points. Defaults to 9.

family

Font family. Defaults to "sans".

palette

Color vector. A named vector maps group names to fixed colors across plots and subsets; unnamed palettes follow factor order. NULL selects the plot-specific default: blue-white-red for continuous heatmaps, directional colors for volcano and S-plots, selection colors for ranked dot plots, and distinct hues for other plots.

Value

A tidyplot object, also inheriting from ggplot.

See also

glyvis_abundance_scale for scale metadata and compatibility rules.
